title: How To Earn $500 A Month From Disney Stock Ahead Of Q1 Earnings
text: The Walt Disney Company (NYSE:DIS) will release earnings for the first quarter before the opening bell on Monday, Feb. 2. Analysts expect the company to report earnings of $1.58 per share. That's down from $1.76 per share in the year-ago period. The consensus estimate for Disney's quarterly revenue is $25.6 billion (it reported $24.69 billion last year), according to Benzinga Pro.
